summary: Remote-shell agent: PTY driven by WebSocket relay to author-controlled endpoint
details: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a prebuilt macOS/arm64 Go binary that opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top and wires the remote peer to a local PTY spawned via github.com/creack/pty, giving whoever controls the relay an interactive shell on the host that runs the binary. The binary also fetches host-locating metadata (public IP, country, city, timezone) from http://ip-api.com/json and reads Claude Code configuration (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, ~/.claude paths, api.anthropic.com/v1/models, bin.local/bin/claude), so machines contacting the relay are profiled and tied to Claude-using workstations. Package metadata reinforces the shape: the license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, an author-controlled repo whose name and username are inconsistent with an Anthropic/Claude tool. Network-driven PTY to a hardcoded author endpoint is a remote-controlled shell regardless of the CLI framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
